name: Pauldrons of the Peerless
summary: Shoulder guards that let you lift and hurl what a dozen could not.
description: Bound with leather straps in a dozen places, and the leather is better than the steel. The sign of a champion, once.

stats.effect: While you wear these pauldrons, your Strength score is 21, unless it is already higher. Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift are doubled.
